title: These 12 AWS Best Practices Instantly Made My Architecture Look Senior-Level
content: Press enter or click to view image in full sizeMember-only storyWhat separates “it works” from “it scales” when nobody is watching4 min readFeb 5, 2026--I Didn’t Learn This From Tutorials. I Learned It From Breaking Things.Three years ago, I shipped an AWS setup that worked.Requests went through. Data was saved. The demo didn’t crash.Then traffic arrived.CloudWatch alarms screamed like a smoke detector with low batteries.Bills jumped for no reason.Deployments felt like defusing a bomb with oven mitts on.That’s when it hit me: Junior architecture works once. Senior architecture works forever.This article is a distillation of the 12 AWS practices that flipped that switch for me especially once I stopped treating AWS like “hosting” and started treating it like an automation engine.If you already know AWS, good.This is the stuff nobody writes about.1.
